items.summary: Approve containment-only execution. No new proposals, change requests, research requests, experiments, telemetry, dependencies, deployments, spend, monetization changes, or requeues are queue-eligible this cycle. Continue only existing repair-or-close, isolated deterministic validation, rollback, deduplication, period-aligned attribution reconciliation, and bounded read-only legal/security evidence work. Preserve private launch gates, parked-site dispositions, unsent outreach, and existing measurement boundaries. Reassess deferred opportunities only after ownership, root cause, validation, rollback, deduplication, and measurement readiness are documented.

Maintain financial containment. Preserve the $4.92 aggregate commission as unattributed and keep revenue attribution, margin, ROI, payback, cost-to-learn, budget capacity, and causal lift unknown. Continue existing reconciliation only; do not infer financial returns from traffic, rankings, clicks, sessions, conversions, orders, shipped items, performance metrics, or AI usage.

Keep private and parked dispositions unchanged. Continue only the existing consolidated legal, accuracy, attribution, measurement, and security evidence work. Keep external outreach unsent and authorize no public exposure, rights-dependent monetization, alert expansion, credential or configuration changes, dependency additions, or deployment.

Retain SEO, UX, accessibility, performance, content, affiliate, monetization, audience, search, repository, and CRO opportunities as deferred backlog only. Technical feasibility is not the blocker; queue entry remains blocked by open failure follow-ups, pending measurements, unavailable operations and security sweeps, incomplete attribution, and missing ownership, root-cause, validation, rollback, deduplication, and measurement evidence.
